h1: PS Hotel Saraburi — A Budget Highway Hotel Built for Stopovers and Wat Phra Phutthabat
intro: If you are driving through Saraburi heading north or northeast and want a cheap overnight stop near Wat Phra Phutthabat, PS Hotel Saraburi is a small hotel right on Phahonyothin Road in Phra Phutthabat district that keeps prices very low. Rooms are simple and minimalist with AC, a flat-screen TV and free Wi-Fi, plus free parking and breakfast included. To be honest, the selling point here is the location on the main highway, close to the temple and convenience stores, and the price — not new rooms or spacious quarters. It suits drivers passing through or pilgrims visiting Wat Phra Phutthabat who want somewhere cheap that does the job, rather than anyone after a full resort experience. From approx. ฿600/night.

body.html: What guests mention most about PS Hotel Saraburi is its highway-side location and very low price. The hotel sits right on Phahonyothin Road in Phra Phutthabat district — easy to find, on the mouth of the soi, with a convenience store nearby and on-site parking. Many reviews say it works well as an overnight stop for drivers passing through Saraburi heading north or northeast, as well as for people visiting Wat Phra Phutthabat, because getting on and off the main road is easy and the rooms are cheap.

The hotel itself is made up of small, simple, minimalist rooms. There are Standard and Superior options in both double and twin layouts, each with AC, a flat-screen TV, a work desk, a private bathroom and free Wi-Fi. The building has an elevator, a 24-hour front desk, a restaurant and breakfast on offer. It is a transit stopover hotel that focuses on convenience and price rather than spacious rooms or design.
"Great location, right by the soi with a 7-Eleven. Friendly, helpful staff and good value for the price — ideal as a stopover or for visiting Wat Phra Phutthabat."

The location is a real strength for pilgrims and anyone exploring the Phra Phutthabat area. The hotel is about 1.5–2 km from Wat Phra Phutthabat Ratchaworamahawihan, close to Khao Noi and the Phra Phutthabat town centre. Being right on Phahonyothin Road, you can drive on up to Lopburi, continue north, or head back to Bangkok with ease. From Bangkok it is roughly a 1.5- to 2-hour drive, making it a handy base for a road trip or a temple visit centred on Phra Phutthabat.

The part worth being straight about is the small rooms and inconsistent upkeep. Some honest reviews note that the rooms are fairly small, a few pieces of furniture are starting to age, and there are occasional cleanliness complaints. It is a stopover hotel with no swimming pool and limited common areas. Being on the main road, some rooms can get traffic noise. If you expect a resort with a full set of facilities, this is not it — but if you can accept a basic room in exchange for a low price and a highway-side location, it remains a workable choice.

On price, standard rooms on the booking platforms start around ฿550–฿900/night depending on the season and room type. The review score on the booking platforms sits around 7.9/10 from a few dozen reviews, which is good for a budget hotel at this level. It scores well on location, friendly staff and value, while its weak points are room size and inconsistent maintenance.

The verdict from real guest reviews: PS Hotel Saraburi suits drivers passing through Saraburi or visiting Wat Phra Phutthabat who want a cheap overnight stop that is easy to find, right on the highway, with convenient parking — more than anyone looking for a resort with a pool and full service. Set your expectations to match what it is — a simple, budget transit stopover hotel — and an overnight stay in Phra Phutthabat will be easy on the wallet.

faq.q: Where is PS Hotel Saraburi and what is nearby?
faq.a: The hotel is right on Phahonyothin Road in Phra Phutthabat Subdistrict, Phra Phutthabat District. It is about 1.5–2 km from Wat Phra Phutthabat Ratchaworamahawihan, close to Khao Noi and the Phra Phutthabat town centre, and roughly 10 minutes from Robinson Lopburi. From Bangkok it is about a 1.5- to 2-hour drive.

faq.q: How much does PS Hotel Saraburi cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from approx. ฿600/night. Options range from Superior Twin, Standard Double and Superior Double up to Deluxe Twin around ฿900. Prices vary by season and room type, so always compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does PS Hotel Saraburi include breakfast and parking?
faq.a: Yes — it includes breakfast and free parking, with an on-site restaurant, an elevator and a 24-hour front desk. There is no swimming pool, however; if you want a resort with a pool, look at properties in the Muak Lek or Kaeng Khoi area instead.

faq.q: Who is PS Hotel Saraburi best for?
faq.a: It is best for drivers passing through Saraburi or pilgrims visiting Wat Phra Phutthabat who want a cheap, easy-to-find overnight stop on the highway with convenient parking. It is about location and price, rather than for travellers seeking a resort with a pool and full service.

faq.q: What are the rooms and service like at PS Hotel Saraburi?
faq.a: Honestly, from real reviews: staff are mostly friendly and helpful and rooms are clean for the price, but the rooms are fairly small, some furniture is starting to age, and there are occasional cleanliness complaints. The hotel is on a main road, so some rooms catch traffic noise — ask for an interior room.

faq.q: What is the easiest way to get to PS Hotel Saraburi?
faq.a: Driving yourself is easiest, since the hotel is right on Phahonyothin Road with free on-site parking. From Bangkok, take Phahonyothin Road towards Saraburi and Phra Phutthabat — about a 1.5- to 2-hour drive. Having a car also makes it easy to visit Wat Phra Phutthabat and continue on to Lopburi or further north.
